description: Canonical haptic waveform programs for Zode. Defined ONCE and rendered by the best engine available on each platform: CoreHaptics (macOS/iOS), WebAudio (web/Android), WASAPI audio synthesis (Windows desktop, which has no rich haptic hardware). Every renderer MUST reproduce the same envelope, timing and relative amplitude.

semantics.track.kind: continuous = sustained waveform with a parameter curve envelope; transient = instantaneous hit with fixed intensity/sharpness
semantics.curve: Array of [normalizedTimeWithinEvent, value] control points. Renderers MUST interpolate linearly between control points unless they support curvature (CoreHaptics CHHapticParameterCurve.controlPoints).
semantics.carrierHz: Carrier frequency for platforms that synthesize the waveform as audio. CoreHaptics ignores this (hardware has no carrier); WebAudio and WASAPI use it as the sine carrier.
semantics.loop: If true the program repeats seamlessly until stop() is called. Used for 'working'.

done.label: Done — triple roll
done.description: Three crisp ascending rolls that swell and fall. Confirms a completed agent task. Each roll is a continuous event whose intensity rises to a peak then falls away, giving the characteristic 'roll' rather than a click.

working.label: Agent working — tiny slow wave
working.description: A very low amplitude, very slow swell that repeats for as long as the agent is busy. Must read as 'alive but unobtrusive' — never a buzz. Loop until stopped.

tick.label: Tick
tick.description: Single crisp click for scrub ticks and key presses.

select.label: Select
select.description: Softer, duller tick used when an item is focused or selected.

drop.label: Drop — file accepted
drop.description: A soft low thud with a short bright tail; confirms an attachment landed.

attach.label: Attach — item received
attach.description: Rising pop used when a file arrives from the dock, a drop, or the share sheet.

open.label: Open — panel in
open.description: Upward swell used when a view or panel opens.

close.label: Close — panel out
close.description: Downward swell used when a view or panel closes.
